title: openOODA Standard Library
content:
## std v1.0.0 — Standard Library

The standard library for openOODA. v1.0.0 released. 8 functional domains, 173 ANCHOR.oo, 0 mod.oo, 256-line cap clean.

### Install

```sh
opm install openOODA/std
```

### The 8 Domains

| Domain | Scope |
|--------|-------|
| `app` | User-facing application primitives (UI, I/O orchestration) |
| `core` | Foundational types: `Option`, `Result`, `List`, arithmetic |
| `fs` | Filesystem operations under `&FsReadCap` / `&FsWriteCap` |
| `hw` | Hardware abstraction: SIMD, accelerators, low-level primitives |
| `meta` | Reflection, AST inspection, tooling primitives |
| `net` | Network operations under `&NetCap` (TCP, UDP, bind) |
| `science` | Hard-science primitives (math, physics, chem, bio, AI, economics) |
| `sec` | Capability security, OCap tokens, Landlock, HMAC, taint tracking |

### Version contract

```
std=1.0.0
oooda=2.10.0
ooda_max=2.99.0
oodac=2.10.0
api_surface=8
```

The std refuses to run if the installed ooda toolchain is outside the declared range. The `api_surface=8` field is a structural check: the loader asserts the std ANCHOR.oo exposes exactly 8 public subdirs.

### Structure

- One ANCHOR.oo per directory (173 total)
- Zero `mod.oo` (banned — see RULES.oot)
- 256-line cap on every `.oo` and `.oot` file
- Each module has a 4-element Academy header (Title, Logline, Setup, Beats)

Full docs: [github.com/openOODA/std/tree/main/docs](https://github.com/openOODA/std/tree/main/docs)
